titre: Le marché mondial des semiconducteurs change d'échelle
sous_titre: Milliards de dollars, 2025 estimé puis 2026 et 2027 prévus

2025.texte: The semiconductor industry is projected to reach USD 772 billion in 2025, representing a 22 percent growth rate.

2026.texte: the calculation for the full-year 2026 market reaches 1,655 billion US dollars, corresponding to annual growth of approximately 108 percent

2027.texte: the calculation for 2027 reaches approximately 2.1 trillion US dollars, corresponding to annual growth of approximately 29 percent
